_about: Canned replies for small talk: greetings, how are you, what does it do, thanks, goodbye. They cost no model tokens and no waiting. Every reply is polite, honest, and invites the person to try a transfer. {try} is replaced by an example command for the channel. Never write the words safe, secure or trusted in a reply (Airlock gives a risk signal, not a guarantee). To add small talk, add an intent here: triggers are matched on lower-case text with punctuation removed. Order matters: the first intent that matches wins, so specific questions come before plain greetings. A reply of "@help" means: use the channel's standard help text from api/message.ts (the GUI and texting versions differ).
